question: How many basis points did MU beat or miss its Q3 2024 GAAP gross margin guidance?

rubric.criteria: 140 basis points beat on Q3 2024 GAAP gross margin guidance

model_answer:
Micron’s **fiscal Q3 2024 GAAP gross margin guidance** was **25.5% ± 1.5%** (range **24.0%–27.0%**). Actual GAAP gross margin came in at **26.9%**.

- **Vs. guidance midpoint (25.5%): beat by 1.4 percentage points = 140 basis points**
- Vs. high end (27.0%): **10 bps below**
- Vs. low end (24.0%): **290 bps above**

So, on the standard midpoint basis, **MU beat its Q3 2024 GAAP gross margin guidance by 140 basis points**.

Sources: [Micron FQ2 2024 release—FQ3 guidance](https://investors.micron.com/news/press-release/2024/Micron-Technology-Inc--Reports-Results-for-the-Second-Quarter-of-Fiscal-2024-03-20-2024/default.aspx), [Micron FQ3 2024 results](https://investors.micron.com/news/press-release/2024/Micron-Technology-Inc--Reports-Results-for-the-Third-Quarter-of-Fiscal-2024-06-26-2024/default.aspx).
judge_reason: The model correctly states a 140 basis points beat.
